sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.9.15

  • Software Updates & Security Scoping Update: Fully connected the Settings Suite update action to the interactive accordion timeline drawer. Isolated Workspace Owner capabilities from platform-level super-admin controls and site administration settings.

2.9.14

  • Software Updates UI Integration: Connected the 'Check for Updates' action in the Settings Suite directly to the redesigned sliding drawer timeline (window.coraOpenUpdateDrawer()), replacing the legacy inline panel with the dynamic accordion updates UI.
  • Strict Workspace Owner Privilege Scoping: Completely isolated platform administration capabilities (manage_options) from the Workspace Owner role (cora_super_admin), ensuring onboarded workspace owners cannot access platform super-admin options or the industry/role switcher.

2.9.13

  • Privilege Leak Hotfix: Fixed 5 hardcoded inline role checks in the admin dashboard that were bypassing the centralized cora_is_super_owner() helper and granting Workspace Owners (cora_super_admin) God-level platform controls including the Industry Mode switcher, Role Switcher widget, Role Preview popover, and in-app update notifications. All 5 checks now route through the single cora_is_super_owner() helper for consistent access gating.

2.9.12

  • Coming Soon Industry Locks: Marked Marketing Agency, IT Services, and Healthcare Practice as 'Coming Soon' with locked badges and disabled pointer events on their onboarding industry selection cards.
  • Workspace Owner Privilege Refinement: Removed cora_super_admin (Workspace Owner) from the platform super-owner capability check. Newly onboarded workspace owners no longer inherit God-level platform controls such as the Industry Mode switcher, Role Switcher, and developer settings — these remain exclusive to platform administrators.

2.9.11

  • Onboarding Step Panel Bug Fix: Resolved CSS rendering issue where all onboarding panels/steps were displayed simultaneously by explicitly defining show/hide display rules on `.step-panel` and `.step-panel.active` selectors.

2.9.10

  • Navigation & Loading Speed Optimization: Drastically optimized the dashboard loading times by converting heavy data queries (Leads CRM, viewing bookings/clients, financials ledger, vault documents, GBP credentials, shifts, and attendance logs) and list assignment processing loops into page-conditional lazy loading blocks.
  • Auto-Updates Performance Patch: Optimized the core updates manager using memory static caching to prevent redundant server lookup queries on double-check events and increased transient query expiration to 12 hours.

2.9.9

  • Premium Onboarding Redesign: Overhauled the onboarding page into a split-column desktop layout featuring a soft mint gradient branding sidebar and a floating CSS-only 3D glassmorphism dashboard scene.
  • Redesigned Step Indicators: Styled progress indicators with clean vector checkmarks and dynamic width transitions.
  • Prefix Icons & Input Group Refinements: Configured forms with left-aligned vector SVG prefix icons.
  • Six-Card Industry Grid: Overhauled industry selection into a 3-column grid featuring Real Estate, Photography, Marketing, IT, Healthcare, and Custom workspaces.

2.9.8

  • Redesigned Software Updates Screen: Replaced the narrow side-sliding drawer with a wide, fully responsive timeline accordion matching the latest layout. Added release channel settings dropdown and active available version card.
  • Interactive Version Accordions: Styled each version (2.9.7 down to 2.9.0) inside collapsibles with thin SVG vector icons matching their change topics. Implemented 'Expand All' / 'Collapse All' toggle controls.
  • Dynamic Live Changelog Parser: Configured JS to dynamically parse raw HTML logs retrieved from the update server to prepend new update history blocks onto the timeline automatically.

2.9.7

  • Onboarding Input Validation: Integrated strict JavaScript and PHP validation rules for Phone/WhatsApp and Contact Email inputs to reject malformed input strings.
  • Workspace Owner Role Enforcement: Guaranteed all newly onboarded users are automatically assigned the 'Workspace Owner' (`cora_super_admin`) role on final activation.
  • Role Invitation Improvements: Empowered Workspace Owners (`cora_super_admin`) and Administrators to invite other Managers and Branch Managers from the UI. Enabled auto-preselection of roles in the invite drawer based on active list filters or the invite_role URL query parameter.

2.9.6

  • Frictionless Multi-Step Onboarding Flow: Completely replaced the legacy registration screen with a modern, frictionless 4-step onboarding wizard. Supports Google OAuth (with local testing mocks), Passwordless Magic Link authentication, profile/business details setup, and dynamic module activation.
  • Visual Theme Typos Fixed: Rectified white-on-white rendering bugs and Tailwind typo classes in the Role Preview banner and settings popover menus.

2.9.5

  • PWA Custom Offline/Maintenance Page: Integrated a premium monochromatic custom connection-idle/offline template served instantly by a robust Service Worker whenever the network is offline or the server undergoes momentary PHP-FPM recycle downtime during upgrades.

2.9.4

  • Connection Recycle Resilience: Implemented FPM/OPcache connection recovery logic. The auto-update interface now handles temporary PHP process restarts gracefully without triggering false-positive network connection failures.

2.9.2

  • One-Click Auto-Updates: Implemented a secure, full-screen step-by-step update interface triggered instantly via custom query parameters.
  • Query Parameter Redirection Preservation: Fixed redirect query stripping in the workspace admin routing.

2.9.1

  • Modularity Optimization: Resolved cross-module script and layout interference by scoping tab switching, search/filter selectors, and dropdown toggle events inside the users view.
  • Duplicate Script Loading Fix: Eliminated redundant inline inclusion of admin-script.js in the dashboard template to resolve double-binding and double-firing click event listeners.

2.9.0

  • Mobile-First User Management: Complete redesign of the Users/Team module with a unified responsive filters toolbar, collapsible mobile filter panel, and mobile card grid layout for team members.
  • Layout Polish: Introduced separate mobile and desktop headers with compact mobile tab navigation and floating 'More' dropdown for secondary tabs (Permissions, Attendance, Custom Roles).
  • Filter Sync Engine: New bidirectional filter synchronization between desktop inline filters and mobile collapsible filter panel with clear-all support.
  • Tab Navigation Overhaul: Synchronized tab active states across desktop and mobile navigation menus with deep-link support via URL query parameters.
  • Attendance Quick Actions: Mobile topbar punch button and responsive punch popover.
  • Leads CRM Refinements: Notion-inspired styling, team assignee support, quick status transitions, activity timelinelogging, and SLA metrics.
